integrity: Proof reconstructed from definitions; third-party topology theorem is credited; finite verification is corroborative; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Class restriction excludes induced 4-cycles and all induced cycles of length >=6; gives a PL orbit model and vertex-decomposability, not a general formula for wedge multiplicities or any linear-representation sphere; possible earlier equivalent equitable-partition theorem remains a priority risk.
title: Equitable orbit compression preserves the chordal–pentagonal independence-complex class
